subject: english
title: REVIEW FINAL TEST 1 - TỔNG ÔN HỌC KÌ 1 TOÀN DIỆN
subTitle: Cambridge Global English Units 3–4.5, Irregular Verbs, Modals, Passive & Blooket Master Set

cards.vietnamese: Dạng V3: built (xây dựng) | bought (mua) | brought (mang lại)
cards.definition: Past participle forms used in passive voice (is/are + V3).
cards.example: Eco-houses are built with local stone. Food was bought at the market.

cards.vietnamese: Dạng V3: ground (xay nhuyễn) | grown (trồng) | frozen (đông đá)
cards.definition: Cacao beans are ground into paste. Vegetables are grown organically.
cards.example: Water is frozen to make ice cubes.

cards.term: V3 of eat, drink, leave, sell
cards.vietnamese: Dạng V3: eaten (ăn) | drunk (uống) | left (để lại/ủ men) | sold (bán)
cards.definition: Beans are left under leaves to ferment. Chocolate is sold worldwide.
cards.example: All the delicious apples were eaten by the children.

cards.term: V3 of make, cut, write, wear
cards.vietnamese: Dạng V3: made (làm ra) | cut (cắt/chặt) | written (viết) | worn (mặc)
cards.definition: Pods are cut with machetes. Books are written in English.
cards.example: Paper is made from wood pulp.

cards.vietnamese: Căn hộ (chung cư nằm trên một tầng của toà nhà)
cards.definition: A home located on one floor of a large building shared with others.
cards.example: She lives in a modern apartment in the bustling city centre.

cards.vietnamese: Nhà biệt lập (không chung tường với nhà nào khác)
cards.definition: A standalone house that is not joined to any other building.
cards.example: They bought a detached house with a spacious front garden.

cards.vietnamese: Nhà một tầng (không có cầu thang bộ)
cards.definition: A house that has only one floor with no stairs inside.
cards.example: My grandparents prefer living in a cosy bungalow without stairs.

cards.vietnamese: Nhà sàn (dựng trên các cọc gỗ cao tránh ngập lụt/thú dữ)
cards.definition: A house built on tall wooden posts above water or land.
cards.example: People build stilt houses along the river to stay safe from floods.

cards.vietnamese: Lều tròn du mục (truyền thống ở Trung Á)
cards.definition: A round, portable tent home traditionally used by nomads in Central Asia.
cards.example: Nomads live in a traditional yurt on the wide grasslands.

cards.vietnamese: Nhà sinh thái (tiết kiệm năng lượng, pin mặt trời, bể thu nước mưa)
cards.definition: A home designed to protect nature using solar panels and rainwater tanks.
cards.example: Solar panels on the roof turn sunlight into clean electricity.

cards.vietnamese: Vật liệu địa phương (đá, gỗ, bùn) & Bãi rác (nơi đổ phế thải)
cards.definition: Local materials are found nearby; a rubbish tip is where waste is dumped.
cards.example: They built the walls from local mud. Recycling keeps plastic out of the rubbish tip.

cards.vietnamese: Chỉ mục đích hành động: để làm gì (to + V0) / để không làm gì (not to + V0)
cards.definition: Answers 'Why do we do an action?'. Formula: Action + to + base verb.
cards.example: Ravi closed the window to keep his room warm. She turns off lights not to waste energy.

cards.term: Modals of Possibility: must / can't / might
cards.vietnamese: must (chắc chắn đúng 100%) | can't (chắc chắn không thể 100%) | might/could (có thể 50%)
cards.definition: Must = sure YES; Can't = sure NO; Might/Could = maybe/not sure.
cards.example: Look at the solar panels! It MUST be an eco-house. It has no doors, it CAN'T be a home!

cards.vietnamese: Made of (chất liệu giữ nguyên dạng) | Made from (chất liệu bị biến đổi qua chế biến)
cards.definition: Made of = material keeps physical state. Made from = chemical/factory change.
cards.example: The chair is made OF wood. Paper is made FROM wood pulp. Chocolate is made FROM cacao beans.

cards.vietnamese: Quả ca cao (chứa hạt) & Thu hoạch (cắt hái từ thân cây)
cards.definition: Large colourful pods growing on trunks. Farmers harvest them twice a year.
cards.example: Inside a cacao pod, there are 30 to 50 white beans surrounded by sweet pulp.

cards.vietnamese: Dao rựa lớn (bổ vỏ quả) & Lên men (ủ dưới lá chuối 5 ngày)
cards.definition: Workers use sharp machetes. Beans ferment under banana leaves to build chocolate flavour.
cards.example: Farmers cut pods with machetes and ferment beans for five days.

cards.vietnamese: Rang (lò nướng), xay nhuyễn thành hỗn hợp sệt (paste)
cards.definition: Roasted cacao beans are crushed and ground into a thick, smooth dark paste.
cards.example: Sugar and milk are mixed with the warm cacao paste to create chocolate bars.

cards.vietnamese: Cải xoong con (cress) & Chậu nhựa tái chế lót bông gòn ẩm
cards.definition: Fast-growing tiny green salad plant grown on wet cotton wool in a recycled pot.
cards.example: First rinse the pot, put wet cotton wool inside, and sprinkle cress seeds.

cards.vietnamese: Bột nhào (dough) | Men nở (yeast) | Bánh ngô mỏng nướng (tortillas)
cards.definition: Yeast creates gas bubbles in dough. Ancient Mayans made flat corn tortillas.
cards.example: Add yeast to flour to make bread rise. Tortillas are baked on a flat griddle.

cards.vietnamese: Giòn rụm (crunchy) | Mọng nước (juicy) | Chua (sour) | Nhiều gai (spiky)
cards.definition: Adjectives describing texture, taste and appearance of food.
cards.example: Apples are crunchy, ripe watermelons are juicy, lemons are sour, and durians are spiky.

cards.vietnamese: Rộng rãi (spacious) | Tiện nghi thoải mái (comfortable) | Cổ kính/lâu đời (ancient)
cards.definition: Adjectives describing spaces and heritage buildings.
cards.example: The living room is very spacious. This ancient temple was built 2,000 years ago.

cards.vietnamese: Hào phóng, rộng lượng (generous) >< Ích kỷ (selfish) | Khổng lồ (enormous)
cards.definition: Generous people give freely. Enormous means extremely large.
cards.example: He is generous and shares his books. The blue whale is an enormous creature.

cards.vietnamese: Some: dùng trong câu khẳng định (+). Any: dùng trong câu phủ định (-) và nghi vấn (?)
cards.definition: Some for positive (+); Any for negative (-) and questions (?).
cards.example: (+) There is SOME milk. (-) There isn't ANY cheese. (?) Do you have ANY apples?

cards.vietnamese: Many: đi với danh từ đếm được số nhiều. Much: đi với danh từ không đếm được
cards.definition: Both commonly used in negative (-) and question (?) sentences.
cards.example: Are there MANY tomatoes? / There isn't MUCH sugar left in the jar.

cards.term: Quantifiers: a few vs. a little
cards.vietnamese: A few: một vài (đếm được số nhiều). A little: một ít (không đếm được)
cards.definition: A few + countable plural; A little + uncountable.
cards.example: We have A FEW bananas for snack. Please add A LITTLE salt into the soup.

cards.term: Quantifiers: a lot of / plenty of
cards.vietnamese: A lot of / plenty of: rất nhiều, dồi dào (dùng được cho CẢ đếm được và không đếm được)
cards.definition: Used in positive sentences with both countable and uncountable nouns.
cards.example: We have PLENTY OF juice and A LOT OF fresh strawberries.

cards.vietnamese: Câu bị động hiện tại mô tả quy trình: Số ít (is + V3) | Số nhiều (are + V3)
cards.definition: Subject + is / are + Past Participle (V3).
cards.example: Cacao beans ARE HARVESTED. The chocolate IS COOLED in moulds before packing.

cards.vietnamese: Từ nối trình tự: Before... -> First -> Then / Next / After that -> Finally
cards.definition: Links process steps in order from start to finish.
cards.example: Before you begin, wash hands. First add flour. Then pour milk. Finally bake.

exercises.question: That big shoe-shaped house ________ be a real house! It's too strange.
exercises.explanation: Dùng 'can't' khi ta chắc chắn 100% điều gì đó là vô lý, không thể xảy ra (It's too strange).

exercises.question: The sky is completely blue and sunny without any clouds. It ________ rain today.
exercises.explanation: Trời trong xanh và nắng chói chang nên chắc chắn không thể mưa (can't rain).

exercises.question: The palace is enormous and made of marble! It ________ be very expensive.
exercises.explanation: Dựa vào chứng cứ rõ ràng (lâu đài cẩm thạch khổng lồ), ta chắc chắn 100% nó rất đắt đỏ (must be).

exercises.question: The building has an unusual shape. It ________ be a museum, but I am not completely sure.
exercises.explanation: Khi dự đoán khả năng 50% nhưng không chắc chắn (not completely sure), ta dùng 'could' hoặc 'might'.

exercises.question: Ravi closed his bedroom window ________ keep his room warm during the cold night.
exercises.explanation: Mệnh đề chỉ mục đích (Infinitive of Purpose): to + động từ nguyên mẫu (to keep his room warm).

exercises.question: Architects used recycled materials ________ the modern eco-friendly house.
exercises.explanation: Cấu trúc chỉ mục đích: 'to + base verb' (to build).

exercises.question: She unplugs her phone charger ________ waste electricity.
exercises.explanation: Chỉ mục đích phủ định: 'not to + base verb' (để không lãng phí điện).

exercises.question: I have ________ milk in the bottle, but I don't have ________ bananas for my breakfast.
exercises.explanation: Dùng 'some' cho câu khẳng định (+) và 'any' cho câu phủ định (-) (don't have any bananas).

exercises.question: There isn't ________ sugar left in the bowl to bake a sweet birthday cake.
exercises.explanation: Sugar là danh từ không đếm được, trong câu phủ định dùng 'much'.

exercises.question: Are there ________ fresh red apples remaining in the kitchen basket?
exercises.explanation: Apples là danh từ đếm được số nhiều, trong câu hỏi dùng 'many'.

exercises.question: We have ________ orange juice in the fridge for everyone at breakfast.
exercises.explanation: 'plenty of' đi được với danh từ không đếm được mang nghĩa nhiều, dồi dào.

exercises.question: Please add ________ salt to the soup before serving it to the guests.
exercises.explanation: Salt (muối) là danh từ không đếm được, dùng 'a little' (một ít).

exercises.question: We only have ________ tomatoes left in the fridge, so we cannot make a large pizza.
exercises.explanation: Tomatoes là danh từ đếm được số nhiều, dùng 'a few' (chỉ còn vài quả).

exercises.question: With COUNTABLE nouns, which quantifiers do we use?
exercises.explanation: Với danh từ đếm được số nhiều, ta dùng 'many' và 'a few'.

exercises.question: With UNCOUNTABLE nouns, which quantifiers do we use?
exercises.explanation: Với danh từ không đếm được (nước, đường, sữa), ta dùng 'much' và 'a little'.

exercises.question: With BOTH countable and uncountable nouns, we can use:
exercises.explanation: 'a lot of' và 'plenty of' dùng linh hoạt cho cả danh từ đếm được và không đếm được.

exercises.question: Cacao beans ________ in big ovens to make smooth chocolate paste.
exercises.explanation: Chủ ngữ 'Cacao beans' là danh từ số nhiều -> are + V3 (are roasted).

exercises.question: The warm chocolate mixture ________ into moulds to create the final bars.
exercises.explanation: Chủ ngữ 'The warm chocolate mixture' là danh từ số ít/không đếm được -> is + V3 (is poured).

exercises.question: At the factory, the roasted beans ________ into a dark, smooth paste.
exercises.explanation: Động từ 'grind' có V3 là 'ground'. Chủ ngữ số nhiều dùng 'are ground'.

exercises.question: A solid wooden dining table is ________ wood because the original material remains unchanged.
exercises.explanation: Khi vật liệu giữ nguyên trạng thái ban đầu (gỗ vẫn là gỗ), dùng 'made of'.

exercises.question: Writing paper is ________ wood pulp after undergoing an industrial factory process.
exercises.explanation: Khi vật liệu bị biến đổi hoàn toàn qua quy trình chế biến, dùng 'made from'.

exercises.question: Delicious chocolate bars are ________ cacao beans, milk, and sugar.
exercises.explanation: Sô-cô-la được biến đổi từ hạt ca cao -> dùng 'made from'.

exercises.question: Which home is a traditional round, portable tent used by nomads in Central Asia?
exercises.explanation: Lều tròn truyền thống của dân du mục Trung Á gọi là Yurt.

exercises.question: A home on one floor of a large building shared with other families is an ________.
exercises.explanation: Căn hộ trong tòa nhà chung cư là apartment.

exercises.question: A house that is standalone and not joined to any other building is a ________ house.
exercises.explanation: Nhà biệt lập hoàn toàn gọi là detached house.

exercises.question: Which house has only one floor with no stairs inside?
exercises.explanation: Bungalow là kiểu nhà một tầng, không có cầu thang bên trong.

exercises.question: A stilt house is built high above land or water on tall wooden ________.
exercises.explanation: Nhà sàn được dựng trên các cột gỗ cao (wooden posts).

exercises.question: Clean energy devices placed on an eco-house roof to convert sunlight into power are ________.
exercises.explanation: Pin năng lượng mặt trời là solar panels.

exercises.question: An eco-house collects and stores water from the roof in a large container called a ________.
exercises.explanation: Bể chứa nước mưa từ mái nhà gọi là rainwater tank.

exercises.question: A designated place where unwanted rubbish and waste are dumped is a ________.
exercises.explanation: Bãi rác tập trung là rubbish tip.

exercises.question: What tool do tropical plantation workers use to cut down and chop open cacao pods?
exercises.explanation: Công nhân dùng dao rựa lớn chuyên dụng gọi là machetes.

exercises.question: What describes the taste of something that is not sweet and sometimes unpleasant, like black coffee?
exercises.explanation: Vị đắng không ngọt của cà phê đen hay socola nguyên chất là bitter.

exercises.question: If someone is willing to give money, help, or time freely to others, they are ________.
exercises.explanation: Người hào phóng, luôn sẵn lòng giúp đỡ và cho đi là generous.

exercises.question: Which fruit adjective describes an apple that makes a loud, crisp sound when you bite into it?
exercises.explanation: Giòn rụm phát ra tiếng kêu khi cắn là crunchy.

exercises.question: Durian and jackfruit have sharp, pointed skins, so they look ________.
exercises.explanation: Vỏ ngoài nhiều gai nhọn là spiky.

exercises.question: What is the V3 (Past Participle) form of the irregular verb 'freeze'?
exercises.explanation: Bảng động từ bất quy tắc: freeze -> froze -> frozen.

exercises.question: What is the V3 (Past Participle) form of the irregular verb 'sell'?
exercises.explanation: Động từ bất quy tắc: sell -> sold -> sold.

exercises.question: Ancient Mayans made flat corn cakes called ________ from maize dough.
exercises.explanation: Bánh ngô nướng dẹp truyền thống của người Maya là tortillas.

exercises.question: What connective shows the first step in a process recipe?
exercises.explanation: Bước đầu tiên trong quy trình dùng 'First'.

exercises.question: To grow cress at home, put tiny seeds on top of wet ________ inside a cup.
exercises.explanation: Trồng cress trong cốc dùng bông gòn ẩm (wet cotton wool).
